newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares ease from highs after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares ease from highs after U.S. data.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended stronger but off the day's highs after pulling back on U.S. jobs data which signalled credit may have to be tightened to prevent the world's powerhouse economy from overheating. A 20 basis point cut in the Portuguese repo rate to 6.50 percent helped support share prices, dealers said. Turnover of 12.1 billion escudos was well above the recent average on Lisbon bourse. Dealers said trade on Monday would depend on the close of Wall Street today. They said they believed that the positive sentiment was likely to remain, although profit taking was imminent.

* The most active shares included 'blue chips' Portugal Telecom (PT), cement group Cimpor and industrial group Sonae, which hit highs in morning trade driven by the bullish mood on Lisbon bourse. PT hit a record high of 5,028 escudos after finally breaking through resistance of 5,000. Cimpor hit an all-time high of 3,800 escudos in morning trade and dealers said it could rise to 4,000 escudos soon.
